description: Changes settings. unit: lb or kg. foodShows: the full list of extra nutrients shown, in order, replacing the old one ([] shows only the macros). exerciseCalories: none, half or all of each day's bonus calories (active calories beyond a usual day, or workout calories when there is no daily count) added to the calorie target. weightGoal: a body weight in goalUnit (or theirs), or 0 to clear it; progress counts from their current trend. baseWeight: what a plate-loaded or Smith machine's sled or bar weighs empty, for one exercise (0 when not counted), or a barbell exercise's bar when it is not the standard 45 lb / 20 kg (an EZ or trap bar); it does not change sets already logged. birthYear: the year they were born, used only to estimate their maximum heart rate for heart rate zones. The change shows in the app with Undo.

goalUnit.description: Unit of weightGoal. Defaults to the person's.

weightGoal.description: Weight to reach, in goalUnit. 0 clears the goal.
